hypothesis: Explicit foreground, midground, and background role assignment improves spatial depth coherence compared with a generic cinematic-depth instruction
interpretation: In this refined-interior portrait context, explicit foreground/midground/background role assignment improved the primary spatial_depth_coherence score by 0.25 over generic cinematic-depth language. Semantic compliance was unchanged, while aesthetic quality decreased by 0.50, technical-defect cleanliness decreased by 0.25, and the overall mean decreased by 0.125. All four explicit-layering outputs received the maximum score of 5 on the primary dimension, and the treatment group showed lower across-replicate variability. This single small-N run weakly supports the tested spatial-depth mechanism in this context, but it does not show general overall-quality superiority. Replication across compositions, environments, subjects, focal lengths, and routes is required before stronger generalization.
limitations: Four replicates per variant are insufficient for a statistical-significance claim.
The review contains one frozen score set, so inter-rater reliability was not measured.
The primary spatial_depth_coherence score was near the 1-5 scale ceiling in both conditions, limiting discrimination.
The host exposed the model family as gpt-image-2 but not an exact model snapshot or reproducible generation seed.

The finding is specific to one refined-interior portrait scenario with a doorway, window, distant furniture, satin outfit, and ceramic vase; replication across other compositions, environments, subjects, focal lengths, and routes is required.

pattern_implications.reason: The pattern already had repeated internal-corpus observations, a human-curated project rule, and compiler/regression support. EXP-005 adds controlled blinded empirical evidence in which explicit spatial-role assignment improved the primary spatial_depth_coherence dimension by 0.25, but aesthetic quality decreased by 0.50, technical-defect cleanliness decreased by 0.25, and the overall mean decreased by 0.125. Keep the pattern supported, compiler-eligible, and enabled at the Director Gate for its existing routes, while recording the direct result as weakly supportive and context-specific pending replication.
